scope: Exact Store ZIP artifact review for hosted release 0.2.550; static artifact evidence only

verdict_a_integrity_and_spec.store_zip_integrity: pass; 2442 entries, no unsafe entry paths
verdict_a_integrity_and_spec.evidence: Fetched artifact 12150453061 from GitHub and hashed the outer ZIP bytes; independently hashed the nested Store ZIP and compared it with release-receipt.json; queried the successful run, tag, and origin/main metadata; parsed the exact Store manifest and compared the policy projection used by scripts/check-cws-release-risk.mjs with the baseline at the tagged source commit.

verdict_b_static_quality.remote_script_url_review: No executable remote JavaScript loader found. Broad URL pattern matches were KaTeX font URLs whose host begins cdn.jsdelivr.net and Redux documentation URLs redux.js.org / redux-toolkit.js.org; these are not JavaScript asset loads.
verdict_b_static_quality.hosted_gate_log: The exact run artifact log reports Store package validation passed and the Chrome Web Store approval-risk gate passed against published baseline 0.2.205.
verdict_b_static_quality.scan_method: Scanned every emitted JavaScript and HTML entry from the exact Store ZIP. Applied the current repository runtime-token list and scripts/detect-remote-script-loader.mjs detectors, then checked for importScripts, PDFObject JavaScript references, the rejected cdnjs URL, and remote script URL candidates.

limits: This is independent static evidence for the exact hosted artifact; no browser or native extension acceptance was performed.
No product acceptance verdict is made. Guest and member native acceptance remain separate gates.
This review does not establish Store upload, submission, review outcome, or publication.
